title: Sphere Fit: algebraic least squares + RANSAC
hints: Expand |p - c|² = r²  →  |p|² = 2 c·p + (r² - |c|²). With k = r² - |c|², this is LINEAR in the unknowns (c, k).
Stack rows [2pᵀ, 1] x = |p|² into an N×4 system and solve with `colPivHouseholderQr()`; check `rank() == 4` (coplanar points → rank 3). Then r = sqrt(k + |c|²).
Conditioning: subtract the centroid first, fit, then add it back to the centre.
RANSAC: sample 4 distinct points, fit, score |‖p−c‖ − r| ≤ thresh, keep the best, refit on its inliers and recompute them.
